sloka: राम लक्ष्मणयोः अर्थे त्वत् सुते वरये नृप ।सदृशाभ्याम् नरश्रेष्ठ सदृशे दातुम् अर्हसि ॥१-७०-४५॥
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ arthe tvat sute varaye nṛpa ।sadṛśābhyām naraśreṣṭha sadṛśe dātum arhasi ॥1-70-45॥

translations.english: "— on behalf of Rama and Lakshmana I ask for your two daughters, O king. Best of men, you should give the two who are their match to two who are theirs."
